annotations.description: Private scrape endpoint failed continuously for 2m; not proof the public API is down.
annotations.runbook: Check target lastError, API readiness, private port 9091 and container health.

annotations.description: Expected scrape target disappeared for 5m plus pending period.
annotations.runbook: Check Prometheus target discovery and targets/applications.json.

annotations.description: Expected scrape target disappeared for 5m plus pending period.
annotations.runbook: Check Prometheus target discovery and targets/applications.json.

annotations.description: Expected scrape target disappeared for 5m plus pending period.
annotations.runbook: Check Prometheus target discovery and targets/applications.json.

annotations.description: >5% server errors with at least 100 requests/5m; excludes Actuator.
annotations.runbook: Open HTTP Performance, compare routes/status, then errors and sampled traces.

annotations.description: >20% 4xx+5xx for sustained traffic; client rejections may be expected.
annotations.runbook: Compare 4xx vs 5xx, routes, release changes and expected rejected requests.

annotations.description: p95 >1 second with >=100 requests/5m; initial development threshold, not a contractual SLO.
annotations.runbook: Inspect slow bounded routes, pool waits, GC and Tempo slow search.

annotations.description: p99 >2.5 seconds with >=1000 requests/5m to limit tail noise.
annotations.runbook: Inspect HTTP histogram and sampled slow traces; tune from a real SLO.

annotations.description: Heap >85% of positive configured maximum for 15m.
annotations.runbook: Check JVM heap, allocation and GC; compare trends before changing limits.

annotations.description: Process CPU fraction >85% for 15m; JVM/container CPU interpretation varies.
annotations.runbook: Inspect traffic, GC, thread/executor load and configured CPU limits.

annotations.description: GC pause time exceeds 0.10 seconds per wall-clock second for 10m; no GC percentile fabricated.
annotations.runbook: Inspect heap occupancy/allocation and GC causes in JVM dashboard.

annotations.description: Active / known positive maximum >90% for 10m.
annotations.runbook: Check pending connections, acquisition latency, slow queries and DB availability.

annotations.description: At least one pending connection remains for 5m.
annotations.runbook: Check saturation, connection leaks, transaction duration and database health.

annotations.description: Sustained failed span export attempts; retries may recover, this is not a loss count.
annotations.runbook: Check Tempo readiness, Collector exporter logs and queue utilization.

annotations.description: Persistent trace queue >80% for 5m; capacity is configured in bytes.
annotations.runbook: Restore Tempo/connectivity, inspect exporter failures; do not erase the queue.

annotations.description: Sustained output errors, exhausted retries or dropped records; one underlying problem can increment multiple counters.
annotations.runbook: Inspect output name on infrastructure dashboard, readiness, filesystem backlog and destination logs.

annotations.description: Loki HTTP push rejections/server errors or chunk flush failures persist; not a complete per-reason discard count.
annotations.runbook: Inspect Loki push status, logs/WAL/free space and Fluent Bit Loki output; no complete discard coverage claimed.

annotations.description: Tempo metrics endpoint unreachable for 2m; query readiness is checked separately.
annotations.runbook: Check internal /ready, Tempo logs, storage and Collector queue.

annotations.description: Infrastructure metrics endpoint unreachable for 3m; Tempo has its own alert.
annotations.runbook: Inspect Prometheus target lastError, endpoint and container state.

annotations.description: >50 failed terminal authentication HTTP operations/10m for 5m; an investigation signal, not proof of an attack.
annotations.runbook: Compare operation trends, deployments and expected negative tests using safe logs only.

annotations.description: >100 terminal authorization denials/10m for 10m; higher threshold accounts for expected rejections.
annotations.runbook: Inspect aggregate 403 routes and configuration; never add user identifiers to labels.
